# matchstick

> Lua-based nftables firewall configuration tool

matchstick compiles Lua config files into native nftables rulesets. It replaces tools like UFW, Shorewall, and firewalld with a single version-controllable Lua file.

## Core Concepts

- **Zones**: groups of network interfaces (wan, lan, dmz). One zone with no interfaces is the firewall host itself.
- **Hosts**: specific IP addresses within a zone for per-machine rules.
- **Services**: named protocol+port combinations (reusable across rules).
- **Policies**: default action between zone pairs (accept/drop/reject).
- **Rules**: specific traffic matches evaluated before the policy.

## Lua API

### Zones & Hosts
```lua
local self = fw:zone("fw")
local wan = fw:zone("wan", "eth0")
local lan = fw:zone("lan", {"eth1", "eth2"})
local server = fw:host("server", { zone = lan, addr = "10.0.0.10" })
```

### Services
```lua
local ssh = fw:service("ssh", "tcp", 22)
local dns = fw:service("dns", {"tcp", "udp"}, 53)
local ping = fw:service("ping", "icmp", "echo-request")
local plex = fw:service("plex", {{"tcp", 32400}, {"udp", 1900}})
```

### Policies & Rules
```lua
fw:policy(wan, self, "drop", { log = true })
fw:policy(self, wan, "accept")
fw:policy("*", "*", "reject")

fw:rule(wan, self, "accept", ssh)
fw:rule(wan, self, "accept", { proto = "tcp", port = {80, 443} })
fw:rule(wan, self, "accept", { service = ssh, rate = util:rate("5/minute", { burst = 10 }), connlimit = 10 })
fw:rule(lan, self, "accept", { service = ssh, mac = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff" })
fw:rule(wan, self, "drop", { saddr_list = "blocklist" })
```

### NAT
```lua
fw:dnat({ iface = wan, service = http, dest = webserver })
fw:dnat({ iface = wan, proto = "tcp", port = 2222, dest = server, dest_port = 22 })
fw:snat({ from = "10.0.0.0/8", oif = "eth0", masquerade = true })
fw:snat({ from = "10.0.0.0/8", oif = "eth0", addr = "203.0.113.1" })
fw:redirect({ iface = lan, proto = "tcp", port = {80}, dest_port = 3128 })
```

### IP Lists
```lua
fw:iplist("blocklist", { type = "ipv4", flags = "timeout" })
fw:iplist("bogons", { type = "ipv4", flags = "interval", elements = {"0.0.0.0/8", "127.0.0.0/8"} })
```

### Packet Hygiene
```lua
fw:laundry({ rpfilter = true, tcp_strict = true, broadcast_drop = true })
fw:exception("invalid", "accept", https)
fw:exception("anti_smurf", "accept", { proto = "udp", port = {67, 68} })
```

### Other Features
```lua
fw:dhcp(wan, "client")
fw:dhcp(lan, "server")
fw:mss_clamp("forward")
fw:docker({ bridges = {"docker0", "br-+"} })
fw:sysctl("net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies", "1")
fw:sysctl("net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding", false)  -- unset derived default
fw:hook({ post_start = "echo applied" })
fw:include("services.lua")
fw:config({ table_name = "matchstick", family = "inet", input_policy = "drop", output_policy = "accept" })
```

### Advanced
```lua
-- Custom chains at arbitrary hooks/priorities (rules are nftables JSON)
fw:chain("prerouting", { type = "filter", priority = "mangle", rules = { ... } })

-- Raw nftables JSON escape hatch
fw:raw_nft({ add = { chain = { family = "inet", table = "matchstick", name = "my_chain", ... } } })
```

## CLI

matchstick is the compiler (pure computation, no root needed).
msctl is the system manager (wraps matchstick + nft for applying rules).

```
# msctl (system management)
msctl enable                                # compile + apply to kernel
msctl disable                               # remove all rules
msctl status                                # show running rules
msctl diff                                  # diff running vs config
msctl check                                 # validate config
msctl edit                                  # edit, validate, apply
msctl show                                  # zone policy matrix
msctl show rules lan fw                     # rules for a zone pair

# matchstick (compiler)
matchstick check config.lua                 # validate
matchstick render config.lua                # print nftables text
matchstick render --json config.lua         # print nftables JSON
matchstick diff old.lua new.lua             # diff two rulesets (- for stdin)
matchstick show matrix config.lua           # zone policy matrix
matchstick show topology config.lua         # network topology diagram
matchstick show sysctl config.lua           # show derived sysctls
matchstick show json config.lua             # full state dump
matchstick import-ufw                       # convert UFW rules from stdin
```

## Architecture

- `src/matchstickpkg/` — pure library (no I/O, no system calls)
- `src/lua55/ffi.nim` — vendored Lua 5.5 C FFI
- `src/matchstick.nim` — CLI binary (pure computation, no nft dependency)
- `msctl` — shell script system manager (wraps matchstick + nft)

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/elee1766/matchstick
cd matchstick
make install
```
